summary: Iter 215bo - Re-test of ModalShell sticky header fix. CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: The original fix (flex-column with flex-shrink-0 header) was correct but the outer container used 'grid place-items-center' which caused the modal to be centered vertically, pushing the top of tall modals above the viewport. Fixed by changing to 'flex items-center justify-center' with 'overflow-y-auto' on the outer container and 'my-auto' on the inner dialog. All 4 modals now show close button visible (closeBtnTop >= 0) after scrolling.
critical_code_review_comments: The original fix in iter 215bn-fix was incomplete. The flex-column layout with flex-shrink-0 header was correct, but the outer container's 'grid place-items-center' caused tall modals to be centered vertically, pushing the header above the viewport.
Fixed by changing outer container from 'grid place-items-center' to 'flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto' and adding 'my-auto' to the inner dialog.
